hook: Javier Milei's government just launched a court battle against the United Kingdom over Falklands oil!

sections.voiceover: Javier Milei's government just launched a court battle against the United Kingdom over Falklands oil!
b_roll: Map showing Argentina and the Falkland Islands

sections.voiceover: On 13 October 2026, Buenos Aires submitted a request to the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea under article 290. Where is the Sea Lion oil project heading?
Except this legal claim targets the Falklands' first commercial oil development directly.
b_roll: Associated Press logo and document excerpt

sections.voiceover: This legal claim escalates the ongoing resource and territorial dispute between Argentina and the United Kingdom. Paragraph 5 governs this urgent UN convention request.
b_roll: UK and Argentine flags side by side

sections.voiceover: The 13 October filing alters the Falklands oil dispute.
